response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced, versatile engineer (15+ years) with strong distributed-systems, low-latency and event-driven work, but the core requirement of this role — modern C++/STL development for industrial automation platforms — is essentially absent from his recent career. His only professional C/C++ exposure was roughly six months at National Instruments in 2014-2015, plus an academic project; the last decade has been JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, Ember/React and DLang. There is no evidence of IEC 62443/SDL secure engineering, MQTT/OPC UA/Modbus protocols, UML-driven architecture documentation, or industrial cybersecurity — all explicitly required. He also has a BS in Computer Science rather than the requested B.E./B.Tech/M.Tech profile, and shows no team-lead/manager scope for a Senior Manager title. Strong engineer, wrong specialization.
strengths: Deep experience with high-throughput, low-latency, event-driven distributed systems (async I/O, fibers, microservices at millions of req/s)
Broad polyglot background including embedded/desktop work, plus strong testing/TDD, CI/CD and craftsmanship discipline
Proven mentoring and communication skills through workshops, courses, conference talks and open-source project leadership
concerns: Minimal and dated C++/STL experience (~6 months, over a decade ago); recent stack is TypeScript/Node.js
No demonstrated IEC 62443 / SDL secure development, industrial cybersecurity, or MQTT/OPC UA/Modbus protocol experience
No industrial automation or IoT platform domain background, and no formal people/technical leadership scope for a Senior Manager role

key_factors.factor: Industrial security & protocol expertise (IEC 62443, MQTT, OPC UA)
